title: Soft and inviting
text: Soft and inviting. I bought this set for the guest room... I love the colors and I believe the photos do them justice for accuracy... There was a kind of musty odor, but washing handled that.  The fabric is soft and inviting, washed up wonderfully.I always update my reviews if helpful info comes to light.
